The camera maintains a stable full-body framing showing her complete figure from head to toe against the spacious school sports ground under bright daytime sunlight. Her facial appearance, expressive eyes, dark hair, body proportions, summer uniform, and the school ground environment remain visually consistent throughout the clip.
